rows.grounds: yastu = yaḥ (relative pronoun, m.nom.sg) + tu (indeclinable particle) 'but whoever'
siddhyādivimukhaḥ = siddhi-ādi-vimukha 'turned away from powers and such', m.nom.sg
antarmahāyāgarūḍhyai = antar-mahā-yāga-rūḍhi 'for ascent into the inner great worship', f.dat.sg
tayaivāsau = tayā (f.ins.sg of tad) + eva (indeclinable) + asau (m.nom.sg demonstrative) 'by that very means he'
kṛtārthakaḥ = kṛta-arthaka 'has attained his goal', m.nom.sg
